text:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT detected: multiple nodes NotReady in inferpool-usw2 over last 2m. Severity: P1. Pager -> @maria

maria: Picking this up — what's the customer impact right now?

kevin: Seeing 503s for a small subset of customers, and elevated tail latency on streaming gen routes. Autoscaler is trying to create pods but some pods are crashing.

maria: Paging infra-sre — @infra-sre can you check node health and kubelet status?

infra-sre: On it. Kubelet restarted multiple times on these nodes: infer-node-az1-07, infer-node-az1-09, infer-node-az1-11. dmesg/journal show GPU driver hangs and IOMMU errors. Pasting key logs.

infra-sre: ```bash
$ journalctl -u kubelet -n 200
Mar 10 12:34:21 infer-node-az1-07 kubelet[...]: E kubelet: runtime/cgo call failed: cuda: driver lost
Mar 10 12:34:23 kernel: NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:af:00): 79, GPU has fallen off the bus.
```

maria: "GPU has fallen off the bus" — that matches runtime errors (container OOM/driver).

kevin: Runtime logs show containers in restart loop with CUDA errors and OOMKilled. Example from runtime logs: 

kevin: ```json
{"ts":"2026-03-15T12:34:22Z","pod":"infer-runtime-abc","msg":"cuda: illegal memory access, aborting run"}
{"ts":"2026-03-15T12:34:23Z","pod":"infer-runtime-abc","msg":"container exited code 137 (OOMKilled)"}
```

alyssa: I'm going to re-route traffic off the unhealthy nodes and force fallback to lower-memory quantized variants for heavy routes to reduce pressure.

eng-platform: Recommend cordon + drain for affected nodes and spin up warm nodes from the warmpool. Also consider taint to prevent scheduling until we verify driver/kernel.

maria: Cordoning the nodes now: `kubectl cordon infer-node-az1-07 infer-node-az1-09 infer-node-az1-11`

infra-sre: Doing a quick kernel probe — looking like regression in nvidia driver after infra deploy ~48h ago. Kernel oops references nvidia_modeset in the trace.

kevin: As a mitigation I'm lowering concurrent requests per container for the gen route to 1 to shrink working set. Also switching some traffic to model-quantized variants. Notifying CS.

oncall-bot: Alert: sla_exposure for route /v1/generate/stream increased to 12% (threshold exceeded).

maria: Customer impact: about 12% errors for ~5 customers (502/503), tracking in INC-2026-0315-01. @customer-success-jen please update customers with a short note.

customer-success-jen: Sending initial notice: "We're investigating transient GPU node issues causing degraded API responses in us-west-2; taking steps to isolate and restore capacity. Will update in 15m."

maria: Starting drain: `kubectl drain infer-node-az1-07 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --force`

maria: Pods are rescheduling but some fail on target nodes due to resource pressure. Autoscaler is firing.

eng-platform: Spinning up 6 additional warm nodes (p4d-8xlarge) to absorb rescheduled pods. Warmpool expansion in progress.

infra-sre: On infer-node-az1-11 found kernel oops referencing nvidia_modeset. Proposing to taint nodes with gpu-unhealthy to prevent new scheduling until patched.

eng-platform: Agree — tainting + restart/patch is safest.

infra-sre: Executing remote BMC reset on infer-node-az1-11 now (powercycle).

infra-sre: BMC reset complete, node rebooted. Post-reboot: nvidia driver loaded, kubelet came up cleanly.

kevin: Running smoke tests before routing traffic back.

maria: Smoke test: `python infra/smoke_tests/infer_smoke.py --target infer-node-az1-11 --model small-test` -> PASS

eng-platform: Removing taint/cordon after validation and bringing node back into rotation slowly.

maria: Notifying customers: "We've restored capacity and started routing traffic back to healthy nodes; you may see a reduction in errors now. We'll monitor closely for 1h and follow up with a post-mortem."

maria: Post-mortem action items (initial):
- pin GPU driver versions fleet-wide to avoid drift
- add nvidia driver healthcheck that auto-taints node on driver hang
- add kernel oops monitor with higher-fidelity alerts
- document playbook for GPU driver rollout rollback + BMC reset steps

eng-platform: Also adding warmpool surge policy and deployment gate for driver rollouts.

maria: If no regression we'll close incident in 1h. Thanks everyone.

kevin: :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: Incident resolved by @maria at 4139876840
